metadata.description: Vendored, version-pinned copies of the Superpowers (engineering execution) and Impeccable (frontend/UX design) plugins, committed into this repo so every clone can enable the same tooling. See .claude/plugins/README.md for provenance, licenses, and how to enable.

plugins.name: superpowers
plugins.description: Core skills library: TDD, systematic debugging, planning, verification-before-completion, code-review, git worktrees. Vendored from github.com/obra/superpowers @ 6.2.0 (MIT).

plugins.name: impeccable
plugins.description: Design fluency for frontend development: 1 skill with 23 commands (/impeccable polish, audit, critique, ...). Vendored from github.com/pbakaus/impeccable @ 4.0.4 (Apache-2.0).
